name: add-mailfully
description: Adds transactional email to your app with Mailfully, or moves it from Resend, SendGrid, Postmark or Nodemailer/SMTP. Works in Node.js, Python, Ruby, Go and PHP, with Django and Rails adapters, and proves a send in test mode before any DNS work. Free for 5,000 emails a month; paid plans from $5 a month for 10,000.
